instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Croatian tweet convey, judged from its tone and from the valence of what it reports or shares?
instructions.rule: Negative needs the poster to be bothered or attacking: their own complaint, mishap or suffering (even joked about), annoyance, sarcasm aimed at someone, moralising criticism, or news of a bad event (crisis, debt, conflict, death, scandal). Deadpan observations about others, banter, calm opinions, statistics, political or institutional events, religious or horoscope texts, bare product specs and practical how-to replies are neutral. Shares of culture, entertainment, celebrities, sport, tech, business deals, interesting articles, jobs, calls to help, and warm replies are positive.

neutral.what: Pure facts, quotes, line-ups, statistics, product names or specs. Political or institutional events, debates and calm opinions. Religious texts, horoscopes. Practical how-to replies, banter, and deadpan observations about others.
examples: Mama gleda njemačku Bachelorette. Žena gleda američki Masterchef. Počinjem štedjet za treći televizor. (Mom watches German Bachelorette. My wife watches American Masterchef. I'm starting to save for a third TV.)
Ne propustite večeras debatu kandidata za predsjednika @EU_Commission @hrtvijesti http://t.co/EgGMQ2dir7 (Don't miss tonight's debate of candidates for Commission president)
RT @321Kuhaj: Divljač se briše papirom, ne pere se vodom. #321kuhaj (Game meat is wiped with paper, not washed with water.)
neutral.cues: sabor (parliament), zastupnik (MP), sjednica (session), debata (debate), horoskop, Evanđelje (Gospel), plain questions, numbers, 'mislim da' (I think), haha
neutral.not_for: The poster's own annoyance or mishap, or bad-news headlines, go negative. Culture or entertainment shares go positive.

positive.what: Joy, praise, thanks, warmth, anticipation. Shares of events, culture, celebrities, sport, tech, business deals, interesting articles, jobs, help appeals, nice check-ins.
examples: Pula: Na Giardinima započela 8. Florija, sajam cvijeća u sklopu obilježavanja Dana Grada: https://t.co/6Jbezcjeer (Pula: the 8th Florija flower fair started at Giardini)
Facebook kupuje WhatsApp - cijena - 16 milijardi USD. http://t.co/hQzOMJraPK (Facebook buys WhatsApp for 16 billion USD)
RT @amaiia_hr: #Zagreb - Volonteri traže prijevoz do poplavljenih područja #poplave (Volunteers seek transport to flooded areas)
positive.cues: premijera (premiere), festival, pobjeda (win), rekord (record), pročitajte (read), pomozimo (let's help), hvala (thanks), bravo, :), :D
positive.not_for: Smileys on complaints or digs go negative. Political events, religious texts, horoscopes, specs and instructions go neutral.

negative.what: The poster complains, suffers a mishap, is annoyed, sad or worried, insults, mocks or moralises. Also news of bad events: crises, debt, conflicts, deaths, scandals, failures.
examples: Naravno, opet kiša u Brusselsu. (Of course, rain in Brussels again.)
Oborili sve rekorde: vanjski dug Hrvatske veći nego ikad http://t.co/YXbdqvWN4o (Broke all records: Croatia's foreign debt higher than ever)
@LucijaCavric oho i ovdje si finjak :P (oho, you're being posh here too)
negative.cues: opet (again), jebiga (damn it), mrzim (I hate), sranje (crap), grozan (awful), gripa (flu), dug (debt), skandal (scandal), :(, :S
negative.not_for: Help appeals go positive. Witty observations about others and calm opinions go neutral.
